verdict.rationale: Expensify's SmartScan documents photo capture with automatic extraction of merchant, date, total and currency, and says scanned receipts match the card transaction automatically. A hands-on user corroborates that it scans receipts and enters the data. The email-forwarding capture path is never documented; the only other digital route is import from integrations like Uber. One older community report says processing took about 20 minutes, against the 'realtime' claim. missing for 10: documented email-forward receipt capture, independent corroboration of automatic receipt-to-card-transaction matching, evidence that processing speed matches the realtime claim

support.subject: As an employee, I can snap a photo or forward an email and the platform OCRs the receipt and files it against the right transaction

citations.quote: Open the app, tap the camera, and SmartScan reads the merchant, date, total, and currency automatically.
The scanned receipt matches to the card transaction automatically, with no manual matching or duplicate entries.
Scan a paper receipt or automatically import digital receipts from integrations like Uber. SmartScan handles both formats the same way.
SmartScan extracts receipt data in realtime, with no batch processing or overnight delays.
